title: Private Barcelona
text: Trip was amazing. Arnau was great as a guide and our driver William was wonderful. The private tour of sites was worth every penny.

title: Barcelona city tour
text: Exceptional service from Arnou as the guide, the driver was amazing as well. Very knowledgeable and treated us like we were apart of his family!
author: Quest11340624193

title: The best of Barcelona
text:
The BEST experience!!!  Matt (owner) contacted me days before our trip to ensure everything was perfect. Then the moment we landed in Barcelona we received a warm welcome from our driver Dan!!  Miguel our guide was so passionate and knowledgeable with his reviews of this beautiful city.  He did a great job pivoting on the fly to accommodates our needs!!  He felt like family by the end of the day. 

Highly recommend!!!
author: Quest16836863087

title: A must !!!
text: Our guide was great, she knew so much about the history and we were so happy to be able to see Barcelona though her eyes ! Great day trip
author: roya_D

title: Matt is a great tour guide
text: Matt was so funny and amazing, he gave a lot of information about everything. The views were incredible and it was a lot of walking but worth it.
author: R358LYsabrinaa

title: Truly an outstanding private tour in Barcelona with Mateus.  It may be the first, but will not be the last!
text: First time doing a personalized private tour and what a wonderful experience.  Our host Mateus “Matt” was so gracious with his time, knowledge and love for Barcelona.  My family took a tour to Girona, then Dali.  Mateus gave a great overview of the history of Girona and Dali, offering numerous tidbits in a way that was never boring.  In addition, he made terrific recommendations for places to shop and eat.  Our family had plenty of time to explore the sites on our own. author: Y7412EZjasona

title: Matt tour guide at Girona and Dali museum
text:
This is our 3rd time in Spain and we always look for Matt as our tour
guide.  We went to Girona and the Dali museum. Matt is friendly, knowledgeable and flexible with time.  It was  great experience for our family!
author: anle1201

title: Best experience with Mateus
text: I went to Dali for the first time with my family and Mateus was the best tour guide ever! He was able to provide so much information about the museum and the history behind Salvador Dali. Thank you so much Mateus!

title: Premiun tour
text:

To repeat. Thanks for everything.

title: Entertaining and informative!
